sitesCount.description: Number of distinct sites visited in the reporting period where this company's trackers were blocked

categories.description: Tracker Radar categories of this company's blocked tracker domains (union across domains). See https://github.com/duckduckgo/tracker-radar/blob/main/docs/CATEGORIES.md

fingerprinting.description: Highest Tracker Radar fingerprinting score (0-3) across this company's blocked tracker domains. 2 or above means likely fingerprinting.

totalCompanies.description: Number of distinct tracker companies blocked in the reporting period, including those grouped under '__other__'. Falls back to the number of named companies when omitted.

totalSitesVisited.description: Number of distinct sites (eTLD+1) visited in the reporting period. Used to express how widespread each company is, e.g. 'was on 4 out of 5 sites you visited'.

topSites.description: The sites visited in the reporting period with the most tracking companies blocked, most first. Up to 5. Powers the 'Which sites had the most trackers' view; omit to hide that view.

etldPlusOne.description: The site, as eTLD+1 (eg: cnn.com). Also used for the fallback favicon.

url.description: A URL on the site, used to load its favicon

trackerCompanies.description: Display names of every tracking company blocked on this site in the reporting period, matching TrackerCompany.displayName
